frameworks.name: Full Context
frameworks.notes: Upper-reference baseline; not a memory framework.

frameworks.name: Mem0 OSS
frameworks.notes: Isolated Python 3.10 runtime uses official Memory APIs, local MiniLM ONNX embeddings, and FAISS. A complete 19-session real LoCoMo Gate passed; this OSS configuration remains distinct from proprietary managed benchmark results.

frameworks.name: EverOS / EverMemOS
frameworks.notes: Current official runtime repository for EverMemOS.

frameworks.name: MemOS
frameworks.notes: Isolated Python 3.10 runtime uses official general_text memory, qwen3.8-max extraction, universal_api embeddings, and embedded Qdrant. Neo4j is required only for the separate tree/graph native track.

frameworks.name: MemPalace
frameworks.notes: Isolated venv, default MiniLM/Chroma bridge, and 1-conversation retrieval Gate are operational; evaluate retrieval and QA separately.

frameworks.name: MemoraX AI
frameworks.notes: 82.65% prediction score is public, but the evaluated implementation is not available.

frameworks.name: Microsoft Memora
frameworks.notes: 2026 system with native LoCoMo and LongMemEval runners.

frameworks.name: LightMem
frameworks.notes: ICLR 2026; includes a multi-framework evaluation toolkit.

frameworks.name: Hindsight
frameworks.notes: Official v0.9.0 Docker service plus a canonical JSON-process bridge; retain→extract→embed→recall smoke passed with qwen3.8-max and DashScope embeddings. Current reproducible run uses the official RRF passthrough setting because the local cross-encoder container stalled during startup; do not label it as the official leaderboard configuration.

frameworks.name: HyperMem
frameworks.notes: ACL 2026 hypergraph hierarchical memory with LoCoMo scripts.

frameworks.name: MemoryOS
frameworks.notes: EMNLP 2025 hierarchical memory baseline; distinct from MemTensor MemOS.

frameworks.name: SimpleMem
frameworks.notes: Reference implementation for structured compression, online synthesis, and intent-aware hybrid retrieval; not wired as a benchmark arm in this endpoint-only optimization.

frameworks.name: LazyMem
frameworks.notes: Anonymous 2026 reference implementation for broad raw-history retrieval, local-window restoration, and query-time KEEP/DROP compression. No repository license is declared, so no source code is copied.

frameworks.name: Mem-PAL
frameworks.notes: Reference implementation for temporally linked log graphs, situation memories, and preference/principle memories. No repository license is declared, so no source code is copied.
